name: watch FSDI job 5
command:
while true; do curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8321/api/jobs | python3 -c "
import json,sys
js = {j['id']: j for j in json.load(sys.stdin)}
j = js.get(5,{})
st = j.get('state','?')
print('job5:', st, (j.get('error') or '')[:150])
exit(0 if st in ('done','error','cancelled') else 1)" && exit 0; sleep 90; done
description: watch FSDI shapes job 5 until terminal
